rubric.scope: Independent synthetic multilingual lexical holdout for owner-authenticated native Web local knowledge search. No personal data, semantic answer generation, or model involvement.
rubric.positiveQueries: 36 body-focused keyword queries and 18 exact file navigation queries; each language has 12 keywords, 3 root-relative paths and 3 exact basenames. 60 documents include 24 index, archive or review notes.
rubric.sourcedHit: Relevant root-relative path appears by rank k and the authenticated exact ref/revision read matches frozen bytes, SHA-256 and the answer span. For keyword cases the authoritative operational fact is relevant; a page merely advertising or referencing the policy is insufficient. For navigation, the explicitly named file is relevant even when the policy text points to it.
rubric.denominator: Every positive query is in its category denominator, including empty and irrelevant responses. Report per-language and per-mode results, top-1 and top-3, returned-source integrity, and six disjoint no-answer controls.
rubric.target: Predeclared primary is sourced keyword hit@1 (target at least 80% aggregate), with exact navigation a separate guard (all 18 expected first). Require no baseline regressions by query and exact source verification on every hit. Negative controls must stay empty. Compare the same bytes without tuning holdout cases.
